_comment: Curated TripWise catalog (India only). Attraction coordinates, durations, entry fees and daily costs are editorial approximations in INR (fees for Indian residents; verify before publishing). dailyCostInr = typical mid-range spend per person per day. No ratings: there is no review source yet. Photos: Wikimedia Commons (author, license and source page per image) or Unsplash; each was reviewed by eye on the CI contact sheets.

destinations.name: Agra
destinations.summary: Home of the Taj Mahal and a cluster of Mughal masterpieces on the banks of the Yamuna.

attractions.name: Taj Mahal
attractions.description: Marble mausoleum, best at sunrise from the main gate.

attractions.name: Agra Fort
attractions.description: Red sandstone Mughal fort with views of the Taj.

attractions.name: Mehtab Bagh
attractions.description: Riverside garden facing the Taj Mahal.

attractions.name: Itimad-ud-Daulah
attractions.description: Inlaid marble tomb nicknamed the 'Baby Taj'.

attractions.name: Fatehpur Sikri
attractions.description: Abandoned Mughal capital 40 km from Agra.

destinations.name: Jaipur
destinations.summary: The Pink City: hilltop forts, palace courtyards and bazaars full of block prints and gems.

attractions.name: Amber Fort
attractions.description: Hilltop fort-palace with mirrored halls.

attractions.name: Hawa Mahal
attractions.description: Honeycomb 'Palace of Winds' facade.

attractions.name: City Palace
attractions.description: Royal residence, museums and courtyards.

attractions.name: Jantar Mantar
attractions.description: 18th-century astronomical instruments in stone.

attractions.name: Johari Bazaar
attractions.description: Gems, textiles and block-printed fabrics.

destinations.name: Kerala Backwaters
destinations.summary: A slow network of palm-lined lagoons and canals, best seen from a traditional houseboat.

attractions.name: Alleppey houseboat cruise
attractions.description: Overnight on a kettuvallam through palm-lined canals.

attractions.name: Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary
attractions.description: Migratory birds on the banks of Vembanad Lake.

attractions.name: Village canoe ride
attractions.description: Narrow canals only small boats can reach.

attractions.name: Kathakali performance
attractions.description: Classical dance-drama with elaborate make-up.

attractions.name: Marari Beach
attractions.description: Quiet fishing-village beach near Alleppey.

destinations.name: Goa
destinations.summary: Palm-fringed beaches, Portuguese-era churches and spice plantations on the Konkan coast.

attractions.name: Palolem Beach
attractions.description: Crescent bay with calm water in South Goa.

attractions.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
attractions.description: UNESCO-listed church in Old Goa.

attractions.name: Fontainhas
attractions.description: Colourful Latin Quarter of Panaji.

attractions.name: Dudhsagar Falls
attractions.description: Four-tiered waterfall reached by jeep through the forest.

attractions.name: Anjuna Flea Market
attractions.description: Wednesday market of crafts, clothes and snacks.

destinations.name: Varanasi
destinations.summary: One of the world's oldest living cities, where life and ritual unfold on the ghats of the Ganges.

attractions.name: Ganga aarti, Dashashwamedh Ghat
attractions.description: Evening fire ceremony on the main ghat.

attractions.name: Sunrise boat ride
attractions.description: Glide past the ghats as the city wakes.

attractions.name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
attractions.description: Revered temple to Shiva in the old city.

attractions.name: Sarnath
attractions.description: Where the Buddha gave his first sermon.

attractions.name: Old city food walk
attractions.description: Kachoris, lassi and sweets in the lanes.

destinations.name: Udaipur
destinations.summary: The City of Lakes: white palaces reflected in Lake Pichola, framed by the Aravalli hills.

attractions.name: City Palace
attractions.description: Sprawling palace complex above Lake Pichola.

attractions.name: Lake Pichola boat ride
attractions.description: Sunset cruise past palaces and ghats.

attractions.name: Jag Mandir
attractions.description: Island palace in the middle of the lake.

attractions.name: Sajjangarh Monsoon Palace
attractions.description: Hilltop palace with views over the lakes.

attractions.name: Bagore Ki Haveli dance show
attractions.description: Evening Rajasthani folk performance.

destinations.name: Leh-Ladakh
destinations.summary: High-altitude desert of monasteries, turquoise lakes and some of the highest motorable passes.

attractions.name: Pangong Tso
attractions.description: Blue lake that changes colour through the day.

attractions.name: Thiksey Monastery
attractions.description: Hilltop monastery resembling the Potala Palace.

attractions.name: Nubra Valley
attractions.description: Sand dunes and double-humped camels.

attractions.name: Leh Palace
attractions.description: 17th-century palace above the old town.

attractions.name: Shanti Stupa
attractions.description: White stupa with sunset views over Leh.

destinations.name: Rishikesh
destinations.summary: Yoga capital on the Ganges at the foot of the Himalaya, with rafting, ashrams and riverside cafés.

attractions.name: White-water rafting
attractions.description: Grade II–III rapids from Shivpuri.

attractions.name: Triveni Ghat aarti
attractions.description: Evening river ceremony with lamps.

attractions.name: Beatles Ashram
attractions.description: Abandoned ashram with murals in the forest.

attractions.name: Ram Jhula
attractions.description: Suspension bridge over the Ganges.

attractions.name: Morning yoga class
attractions.description: Drop-in session at an ashram.

destinations.name: Mumbai
destinations.summary: India's maximum city: colonial architecture, sea-front promenades and a legendary street-food scene.

attractions.name: Gateway of India
attractions.description: Basalt arch overlooking the harbour.

attractions.name: Elephanta Caves
attractions.description: Rock-cut Shiva temples reached by ferry.

attractions.name: Marine Drive
attractions.description: Sea-front promenade, the 'Queen's Necklace' at night.

attractions.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus
attractions.description: Gothic railway station, a UNESCO site.

attractions.name: Street food at Juhu Beach
attractions.description: Pav bhaji and bhel puri by the sea.

destinations.name: Delhi
destinations.summary: A capital of layered empires: Mughal monuments, bustling bazaars and some of India's best food.

attractions.name: Humayun's Tomb
attractions.description: Garden tomb that inspired the Taj Mahal.

attractions.name: Qutub Minar
attractions.description: 73 m victory tower from the 12th century.

attractions.name: Red Fort
attractions.description: Mughal palace-fortress in Old Delhi.

attractions.name: Old Delhi food walk
attractions.description: Chandni Chowk parathas, jalebis and kebabs.

attractions.name: India Gate
attractions.description: War memorial on Kartavya Path, lively at dusk.

destinations.name: Hampi
destinations.summary: Ruins of the Vijayanagara capital scattered across a surreal landscape of boulders and banana fields.

attractions.name: Virupaksha Temple
attractions.description: Living temple at the heart of the bazaar.

attractions.name: Vittala Temple
attractions.description: Famous stone chariot and musical pillars.

attractions.name: Hemakuta Hill sunset
attractions.description: Boulder-top views over the temples.

attractions.name: Coracle ride
attractions.description: Round basket boats on the Tungabhadra.

attractions.name: Royal Enclosure
attractions.description: Stepped tank and Mahanavami platform.

destinations.name: Darjeeling
destinations.summary: Hill station of tea gardens and toy trains, with dawn views of Kanchenjunga.

attractions.name: Tiger Hill sunrise
attractions.description: Dawn light on Kanchenjunga.

attractions.name: Toy train joyride
attractions.description: UNESCO-listed narrow-gauge railway.

attractions.name: Happy Valley Tea Estate
attractions.description: Tea factory tour and tasting.

attractions.name: Batasia Loop
attractions.description: Spiral railway loop with a war memorial.

attractions.name: Peace Pagoda
attractions.description: Japanese temple with valley views.

destinations.name: Munnar
destinations.summary: Rolling tea estates and misty hills in the Western Ghats.

attractions.name: Eravikulam National Park
attractions.description: Home of the endangered Nilgiri tahr.

attractions.name: Tata Tea Museum
attractions.description: History and processing of Munnar tea.

attractions.name: Mattupetty Dam
attractions.description: Lake with boating amid the hills.

attractions.name: Top Station
attractions.description: Viewpoint on the Kerala–Tamil Nadu border.

attractions.name: Tea estate walk
attractions.description: Guided walk through plantations.

destinations.name: Andaman Islands
destinations.summary: White-sand beaches, coral reefs and dense forests in the Bay of Bengal.

attractions.name: Radhanagar Beach
attractions.description: Wide white-sand beach on Swaraj Dweep (Havelock).

attractions.name: Elephant Beach snorkelling
attractions.description: Reef snorkelling reached by boat.

attractions.name: Cellular Jail
attractions.description: Colonial prison and evening light-and-sound show.

attractions.name: Scuba try dive
attractions.description: Beginner dive with an instructor.

attractions.name: Kalapathar Beach
attractions.description: Quiet beach lined with black rocks.

destinations.name: Jaisalmer
destinations.summary: The Golden City: a living sandstone fort rising from the Thar Desert.

attractions.name: Jaisalmer Fort
attractions.description: Living fort with homes, temples and shops.

attractions.name: Patwon ki Haveli
attractions.description: Five intricately carved merchant mansions.

attractions.name: Sam Sand Dunes camel safari
attractions.description: Sunset ride and folk music in the desert.

attractions.name: Gadisar Lake
attractions.description: Lake lined with shrines and chhatris.

attractions.name: Bada Bagh
attractions.description: Royal cenotaphs at sunset.

destinations.name: Amritsar
destinations.summary: Spiritual centre of the Sikh faith and a city famous for its hospitality and food.

attractions.name: Golden Temple (Harmandir Sahib)
attractions.description: Gilded shrine on a sacred pool, open day and night.

attractions.name: Langar at the Golden Temple
attractions.description: Free community meal served to all.

attractions.name: Wagah border ceremony
attractions.description: Daily flag-lowering ceremony at the border.

attractions.name: Jallianwala Bagh
attractions.description: Memorial garden to the 1919 massacre.

attractions.name: Kulcha trail
attractions.description: Stuffed kulchas with chole at local dhabas.
